gbm_population_evidence.quote: Novel Gamma-Delta (γδ)T Cell Therapy for Treatment of Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
Must have histologically or cytologically confirmed glioblastoma multiforme prior to administration of the DRI γδ T cell injection.

candidate_evidence.quote: The cell therapy that is being used in this study is called gene-modified gamma delta T cells or Drug Resistant Immunotherapy (DRI).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Novel Gamma-Delta (γδ)T Cell Therapy for Treatment of Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

agents.active_moiety: gene-modified gamma delta t cell therapy

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] DRI cell therapy: Drug Resistant Immunotherapy with gamma delta modified T cells to be resistance to temozolomide will be infused into the surgical cavity

agents.drug_class_hint: temozolomide-resistant (MGMT-expressing) gene-modified gamma delta T cell therapy

role_evidence.quote: The only arm will receive the DRI modified gamma delta T cells following standard therapy with radiation and temozolomide chemotherapy concurrent.

coder_notes: Temozolomide is named in the protocol text and in the arm description (given to every patient) but is not a separately registered intervention. Glioblastoma is named in the title and inclusion criteria; conditions field only says Brain Tumor Adult.
